profileFindings.observedDomMutations: Only save-status/conflict UI attribute updates; no list/editor/checklist/history subtree replacement.
profileFindings.interpretation: The 403 ms historical Playwright wall value was not reproduced. A focused replay of the same End+x Playwright calls measured candidate p95 83.23 ms while browser input-to-two-frame paint was 29.9 ms. This does not establish the exact cause of the earlier outlier or physical-device latency. Prefetch and cache write toggles did not change browser input metrics; no prefetch or IndexedDB writes occurred in the measured typing interval.

The available IAM boundary is database-wide, not vault-specific. Requalifying requires restoration of an explicitly scoped Preview identity and database access; this task made no permission change, so candidate Vercel OIDC/Firestore reads were not run.
